title: Ask, Listen and Respond in a Biology Conversation
objective: Students practice question forms, clarification, and polite repair when they do not understand.
context: Partner A saw six birds at the pond. Partner B heard only the word “birds”.

items.prompt: Partner B: ask a question about the number.
items.answer: How many birds did you see?

items.prompt: Partner A: give the number and place in one sentence.
items.answer: I saw six birds at the pond.

items.prompt: Partner B: ask for slower speech. Partner A: repeat the answer.
items.answer: Listen for a polite request and a clearly repeated answer.
items.hint: Try: Could you say that more slowly, please?
